verdict.rationale: Algolia serves an llms.txt at its root, and a probe confirmed HTTP 200. It also serves markdown docs at /doc.md that point agents to the llms.txt documentation index, and the quickstart links to a dedicated "Build with AI" guide for preparing agents. An official agent-skills repository adds further agent-oriented material. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or per-page markdown beyond the docs index.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
